regions.merged_text: Brother Leo and Br. Rufin and Br. Gerard and often one or the other Rev. Father have helped me thus. After all, as long as the wonderful work is done and it goes to the same headquarters, what's the difference who coes it. That Heaven is pleased with the work of the Associ- ation and you Promoters have mighty big share in the merrit - ought to be manifest from the number and often the astonishing nature and magnitude of the favors we have reported as thru the same great source of blessings. Thanks and glory to God!

regions.merged_text: Regretting our failure and hoping that this may be at least nearly satisfactory I beg to remain, Sincerely and Gratefully Yours, In Christ - The divine Master Missioner,
